data: What is the precision value of the red line at a recall value of approximately 0.9?

The red line represents PA-TMR. At a recall value of approximately 0.9, the precision value of the red line can be observed. From the graph, the red line intersects the y-axis at a precision value of approximately 0.85. Therefore, the precision value of the red line at a recall value of approximately 0.9 is around 0.85.
